name: obsidian-mcp-enterprise
description: Enterprise-grade MCP server for Obsidian vaults: read, write, search, and manage notes.

vault_path.title: Obsidian vault
vault_path.description: Path to your Obsidian vault (the folder that contains the .obsidian directory).

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note's content, frontmatter, and tags.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally within a directory.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search by filename, title, tags, and content.

tools.name: get_note_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata and tags for a note.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Update a note, preserving frontmatter by default.

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Append content to an existing note.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note from the vault.

tools.name: get_vault_stats
tools.description: Vault-wide stats: count, size, recent activity.
